description: cjpegli - JPEG encoder from the jpegli project, shipped inside the libjxl release archives
notes: Pinned on purpose: v0.11.2 is the last libjxl release that ships cjpegli.exe. v0.12.0 dropped it from every Windows archive, so checkver/autoupdate are deliberately absent - an automatic bump would silently install a build without the tool.

Not deprecated, spun off: libjxl v0.12.0 removed the jpegli codebase because it now lives at github.com/google/jpegli (libjxl PR #4657). That repo is active but has published no releases yet, so there is no newer prebuilt binary to point at. Re-point this manifest once it ships Windows assets.
Only the x64 static archive carries cjpegli - the dynamic jxl-x64-windows.zip of the same release contains just brotli.exe.
This is a static build: cjpegli.exe has no bundled DLL dependencies.
The archive holds ~24 other tools (cjxl, djxl, djpegli, ssimulacra2, ...); they are removed on install since this package exists for cjpegli only. Drop the post_install line to keep them.
